company.name: Glisten AI
company.shortDescription: Glisten AI cleans, enriches, and structures product and listing data.
company.description:
Glisten transforms product and listing information into workable data.

They consolidate and combine inconsistent data, classify products according to a standardized taxonomy, generate new information about products, and represent product information in a way that is ingestible for machine learning, search, analytics, and other technology and data solutions.

Sarah Wooders and Alice Deng established it in San Francisco, California.

items.title: Glisten uses computer vision to break down product photos to their most important parts
